settings.headline: Come and see a morning at Tarrenhurst
settings.subtitle: Open mornings run in the fall, and private tours run most weekdays. Call the admissions office to arrange a visit.

settings.headline: Ways to visit
settings.intro: Arranged by phone or email; there is no booking form on this site.

settings.headline: Finding us
settings.body:
Tarrenhurst School, 1 School Hill, Tarrenhurst (fictional). Visitor parking is by the Tarren Building; the admissions office is the first door on the left.

Morning buses run from the town center and the north villages.
settings.note: Admissions: weekdays 8:00 am – 4:30 pm. Main office: (555) 014-1000.
